cards.example_en: Can you subtract fifteen from forty without using a calculator?
cards.example_zh: 你能不用计算器从四十里面减去十五吗？

cards.example_en: Take the subway to the museum.
cards.example_zh: 坐地铁去博物馆。

cards.example_en: After the broken oven caused a fire, the shop owner decided to sue the company.
cards.example_zh: 坏烤箱引起火灾后，店主决定起诉那家公司。

cards.example_en: My suggestion was to start the meeting earlier.
cards.example_zh: 我的提议是把会议提前开始。

cards.example_en: That was a super performance.
cards.example_zh: 那是一场极好的演出。

cards.example_en: My cousin dressed as superman for the school play and made everyone laugh.
cards.example_zh: 我表弟在学校话剧里扮成超人，把大家都逗笑了。

cards.example_en: Fish and rice made a hot supper after swimming.
cards.example_zh: 游完泳以后，晚饭是热乎的鱼和米饭。

cards.example_en: They surf when the waves are high.
cards.example_zh: 浪大的时候他们去冲浪。

cards.example_en: Trees surround the small lake.
cards.example_zh: 树木环绕着小湖。

cards.example_en: Under the roof of our old house, a swallow built its nest.
cards.example_zh: 在我们老房子的屋顶下，一只燕子筑了巢。

cards.example_en: We saw a white swan swimming on the lake during our trip.
cards.example_zh: 旅行时我们看见一只白天鹅在湖面上游。

cards.example_en: The children swing in the park.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们在公园里荡秋千。

cards.example_en: Some families switch from driving to cycling this month.
cards.example_zh: 这个月有些家庭从开车转变为骑自行车。

cards.example_en: Mum poured maple syrup over the hot pancakes at breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 早餐时妈妈把枫糖浆浇在热煎饼上。

cards.example_en: Our heating system rattles whenever the wind rises.
cards.example_zh: 风一大，我们的供暖系统就咔咔作响。

cards.example_en: Look at the price tag on this jacket; it says eighty yuan.
cards.example_zh: 看看这件夹克上的价格标签，上面写着八十元。

cards.example_en: Dad's tale about a brave mouse lasted until bedtime.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸讲的勇敢小老鼠的故事一直讲到睡觉。

cards.example_en: Beating our old score is the target for Friday.
cards.example_zh: 超过我们以前的分数，是星期五的目标。

cards.example_en: Outside the hotel, the taxi-driver helped us carry our heavy bags.
cards.example_zh: 在酒店外面，出租车司机帮我们拿了沉重的行李。

cards.example_en: A tear rolled down her cheek.
cards.example_zh: 一滴眼泪从她脸颊滚落。

cards.example_en: Older students should not tease younger ones in the playground.
cards.example_zh: 大同学不应该在操场上取笑年幼的同学。

cards.example_en: Add one teaspoon of sugar if the coffee tastes too bitter.
cards.example_zh: 如果咖啡太苦，就加一茶匙糖。

cards.example_en: Every teen in our class wants to visit the science museum.
cards.example_zh: 我们班每个青少年都想去参观科学博物馆。

cards.example_en: The office telephone rang all through lunch break.
cards.example_zh: 办公室的电话响了整整一个午休。

cards.example_en: We argued about the film we saw on television.
cards.example_zh: 我们就在电视上看到的那部电影争论了起来。

cards.example_en: Dad lost his temper when the dog chewed his new shoes.
cards.example_zh: 狗咬坏了爸爸的新鞋，他发了脾气。

cards.example_en: The old temple is on the hill.
cards.example_zh: 古老的寺庙在山上。

cards.example_en: Students felt tense before the final maths test on Monday.
cards.example_zh: 周一期末数学考试前，学生们感到紧张。

cards.example_en: Everyone agreed the seafood dinner at the harbour was terrific.
cards.example_zh: 大家都觉得港口的海鲜晚餐好极了。

cards.example_en: The police investigated the theft.
cards.example_zh: 警察调查了这起盗窃。

cards.example_en: Courage is the theme running through this novel.
cards.example_zh: 勇气是贯穿这本小说的主题。

cards.example_en: The experiment supports the theory.
cards.example_zh: 实验支持这个理论。

cards.example_en: Someone saw a thief steal a bicycle outside the school gate.
cards.example_zh: 有人看见一个小偷在校门外偷走了自行车。

cards.example_en: Do a thorough check before you leave.
cards.example_zh: 离开前做一次彻底检查。

cards.example_en: To mend this torn shirt, I need a needle and some thread.
cards.example_zh: 要补这件破衬衫，我需要一根针和一些线。

cards.example_en: He hurt his thumb while cutting vegetables for dinner.
cards.example_zh: 他晚饭切菜时伤到了拇指。

cards.example_en: Remember to tick the correct answer on your test paper.
cards.example_zh: 记得在试卷上给正确答案打勾。

cards.example_en: While we walked along the beach, the tide came in quickly.
cards.example_zh: 我们沿海滩走的时候，潮水很快涨了上来。

cards.example_en: Check the train timetable before you leave for the station.
cards.example_zh: 去车站之前先查看火车时刻表。

cards.example_en: On the way to my uncle's farm, the front tyre went flat.
cards.example_zh: 去叔叔农场的路上，前轮胎瘪了。

cards.example_en: What is the title of this book?
cards.example_zh: 这本书的标题是什么？

cards.example_en: The toast popped up burnt, so I scraped it.
cards.example_zh: 吐司弹起来已经糊了，我把糊的地方刮掉。

cards.example_en: She stubbed her toe on the chair while walking to the kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 她走向厨房时，脚趾撞到了椅子。

cards.example_en: Drivers must pay a toll before they enter this long highway.
cards.example_zh: 司机进入这条长公路之前必须缴纳通行费。

cards.example_en: At lunch today, the hot soup burned my tongue.
cards.example_zh: 今天午饭时，热汤烫到了我的舌头。

cards.example_en: He went to the dentist with a toothache.
cards.example_zh: 他牙疼去看了牙医。

cards.example_en: I packed a toothbrush and a towel for the weekend trip.
cards.example_zh: 我为周末旅行装了一把牙刷和一条毛巾。

cards.example_en: We are almost out of toothpaste, so please buy a new tube.
cards.example_zh: 牙膏快用完了，请再买一支。

cards.example_en: Our topic for the debate is phones in school.
cards.example_zh: 我们这场辩论的话题是学校里能不能用手机。

cards.example_en: After the rain, the tortoise moved slowly across the garden.
cards.example_zh: 雨后，乌龟慢慢地爬过了花园。

word.example_en: It is faster to go by subway.
I need to make a telephone call to the clinic.
word.example_zh: 我需要给诊所打个电话。
